bank.retain_mission: Extract high-level architectural decisions, system boundary choices, technology stack selections, structural trade-offs, and design post-mortems. Ignore intermediate sequential-thinking thought chains, raw AST graph outputs, and transient line-level edits.
bank.observations_mission: Track architectural evolution, key design invariants, system component relationships, and trade-off decisions over time.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize an authoritative architectural breakdown detailing system boundaries, core design principles, trade-offs made, component dependencies, and design post-mortems.

mental_models.name: System Architecture & Design Patterns
mental_models.source_query: What are the core architectural principles, component interfaces, design patterns, and system boundaries in this codebase?

mental_models.name: Design Trade-Offs & Rationale
mental_models.source_query: What key architectural trade-offs were evaluated? Why were specific libraries, frameworks, or data structures chosen over alternatives?

mental_models.name: Architectural Post-Mortems & Anti-Patterns
mental_models.source_query: What past architectural failures, anti-patterns, or refactoring post-mortems were identified to avoid repeating mistakes?
